T: Roast beast. Who pudding. No stealing.
D: A grumpy green hermit plans to steal Christmas from the cheerful town below his mountain.
P: Serve the roast beast when the Whos sit down to their Christmas feast.
S: Cornflakes stirred through melted marshmallow and butter tinted green, shaped into little wreaths, red lollies pressed on as berries.
the mountain where the Grinch lives
A tall pile of cheddar and gouda cubes, grapes and crackers stacked into a peak, a green herb dip at the base.
M: the Christmas feast he tries to steal
Beef rib roast seasoned overnight, roasted at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C, rested, carved at the table with Yorkshire puddings, roast potatoes and gravy.
Corned beef, potato and onion fried hard in butter until crisp, topped with fried eggs and chives.
W: the Christmas pudding on every Who table
Bread and butter pudding made with fruit loaf, layered in a dish, soaked in a vanilla custard of eggs, milk and cream, baked at 170C for 40 minutes.
K: a heart that grows three sizes
Lime sorbet scooped into a punch bowl, topped with lemonade and pineapple juice so it froths up green.

s.how: Melt 50g butter with 200g marshmallows and a few drops of green colouring. Stir through 120g corn flakes until coated. Shape spoonfuls into little wreaths on baking paper and press on red lollies as berries. Set for an hour.

s.note: the mountain where the Grinch lives
s.how: Cube 200g vintage cheddar and 200g gouda and stack them with 300g grapes into a tall peak on a board. Lean 1 box crackers around the base and serve with 200g sour cream blended with a bunch of parsley, salt and lemon.

m.note: the Christmas feast he tries to steal
m.how: Season a 2kg beef rib roast overnight. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes then 160C to 52C inside and rest. Roast 1kg potatoes. Whisk 3 eggs, 150g flour and 300ml milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C for 20 minutes. Make gravy with 400ml stock.

w.note: the Christmas pudding on every Who table
w.how: Butter 8 slices fruit loaf and layer in a dish. Whisk 4 eggs, 400ml milk, 200ml cream, 60g sugar and vanilla and pour over. Rest 20 minutes, then bake at 170C for 40 minutes until puffed and golden.

d.note: a heart that grows three sizes
d.how: Scoop 500ml lime sorbet into a punch bowl. Pour over 1L lemonade and 250ml pineapple juice so it froths up green. Add lime slices and ladle into cups.
